card.name: Linking words in overdose treatment steps
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, and, to) inside overdose-management instructions, right after 'priorities are' or 'measures' or after 'protected airway'. They come before the next treatment action.

modes.label: After 'priorities are'
modes.description: The word 'the' right after 'priorities are' in the overdose section.
modes.example: In case of overdose, priorities are<< the>> re-establishment of a patent and protected

modes.label: 'and' after airway
modes.description: The word 'and' joining airway protection to ventilation support.
modes.example: re-establishment of a patent and protected airway<< and>> institution of assisted or controlled ventilation, if

modes.label: 'to' after measures
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'measures' in overdose instructions.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE Take measures<< to>> support blood pressure, if necessary.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing with a further supportive-care action, as with 'further' and 'via'.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in overdose treatment lists, just before the next supportive step is named.
